paper.title: Linear and Neural Dueling Bandits with Delayed Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Linear Dueling Bandits With Delayed Feedback
unmapped: Feedback arriving after a hard observation threshold M is lost (censored); arrival probability rho = P(D_t <= M)
the learner knows the observation probability rho and the threshold M
the learner knows the bound L on pairwise feature differences
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t \in [T]$, the agent receives a set of arms $\mathcal{X}_t$ and selects a pair $(x_{t,1}, x_{t,2})$... the preference feedback $y_t$ is not immediately available; instead, it is observed after a random delay $D_t$. We impose a hard observation threshold $M$... we assume $\rho$ is known... $f(x) = \theta^\top \phi(x)$ ... $\|\phi(x)\|_2 \le 1$.

settings.name_in_paper: Neural Dueling Bandits With Delayed Feedback
unmapped: Feedback arriving after a hard observation threshold M is lost (censored); arrival probability rho = P(D_t <= M)
the learner knows the observation probability rho, the threshold M and the NTK norm bound B
K arms per round (finite), contexts on the unit sphere
settings.definition_quote: In the neural setting,we allow the reward functions $f$ to be non-linear functions. We approximate $f(x)$ using a fully connected neural network (NN) $h(x; \theta)$ with depth $L \ge 2$, width $m$, and ReLU activations... Assumption: B1. |f(x)| <= 1; B2. H >= lambda_0 I; B3. ||x||_2 = 1 and x_j = x_{j+d/2}.

algorithms.name: LDB-DF (Linear Dueling Bandits with Delayed Feedback)
NDB-DF (Neural Dueling Bandits with Delayed Feedback)

symbols.rho: probability that feedback arrives within the threshold, P(D_t <= M)
symbols.M_delay: hard observation threshold on the delay (paper's M)

conditions: Assumption 2.1: mu Lipschitz with L_mu, min derivative of link >= kappa_mu > 0, ||phi(x_{t,1}) - phi(x_{t,2})|| <= L

source.label: thm:linear_regret
source.quote: Suppose Assumption \ref{ass:standard} holds. Let $\lambda > \kappa_\mu L^2$. With probability at least $1-\delta$ for some $\delta\in(0,1)$, the cumulative regret of LDB-DF satisfies: R_T = \tilde{O}( \frac{1}{\rho\kappa_\mu} ( \sqrt{d} + M ) d \sqrt{T} ) = \tilde{O}( \frac{M}{\rho\kappa_\mu} d \sqrt{T} ).

results.notes: kappa_mu mapped to c_mu. Regret is average-utility dueling regret 2f(x*)-f(x1)-f(x2). The theorem also states the simplified form M d sqrt(T)/(rho kappa_mu) (using M>=1). Algorithm pseudocode uses beta_t/kappa_mu in the bonus while proof uses beta_t/(rho kappa_mu) — inconsistency in paper. Contexts/arm sets unspecified so mapped to adversarial contexts.

symbols.rho: probability that feedback arrives within the threshold, P(D_t <= M)
symbols.M_delay: hard observation threshold on the delay (paper's M)

tuning: beta_t = sqrt(2 log(1/delta) + d log(1 + t L^2 kappa_mu/(d lambda))) + M L + sqrt(lambda kappa_mu)

source.label: thm:linear_regret_app
source.quote: Let $\beta_t$ be defined as in \eqref{eq:linear_beta_def} and suppose $\lambda > \kappa_\mu L^2$. With probability at least $1-\delta$: R_T \le \frac{3}{2} \frac{\beta_T}{\rho\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{2dT\log(1+TL^2\kappa_\mu/(d\lambda))} = \tilde{O}(\frac{M}{\rho\kappa_\mu}\,d\sqrt{T}).

results.notes: Explicit restatement of Theorem 4.1 with beta_T substituted. Proof correctness questionable (e.g. bias term), recorded as stated.

symbols.rho: probability that feedback arrives within the threshold, P(D_t <= M)
symbols.M_delay: hard observation threshold on the delay (paper's M)
symbols.B_ntk: NTK norm bound sqrt(2 h^T H^{-1} h) (paper's B)

conditions: Assumption 2.2: |f(x)| <= 1, NTK matrix H >= lambda_0 I, ||x||_2 = 1 and x_j = x_{j+d/2}
network width m sufficiently large (polynomial in T, L, K, 1/kappa_mu, 1/lambda_0, 1/lambda, log(1/delta))
d_eff = log det(kappa_mu/lambda H' + I) is the effective dimension of the pairwise NTK Gram matrix
tuning: nu_T = (beta_T/rho + B sqrt(lambda/kappa_mu) + 1 + M/(kappa_mu m rho)) kappa_mu/lambda

source.label: thm:neural_regret
source.quote: Suppose Assumption \ref{ass:neural_assumptions} holds. Let $m$ be sufficiently large. With probability at least $1-\delta$ for some $\delta\in(0,1)$, the cumulative regret of NDB-DF satisfies: R_T = \tilde{O}( ( \frac{\sqrt{\tilde{d}}}{\rho\kappa_\mu} + B \sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{\kappa_\mu}} + \frac{M}{\kappa_\mu m \rho} ) \sqrt{\tilde{d} T} ) = \tilde{O}( \frac{M}{\rho\kappa_\mu} \tilde{d} \sqrt{T} ), where $\tilde{d}$ is the effective dimension of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) matrix.

results.notes: Restated as Theorem C.6 in appendix. tilde d mapped to d_eff.
